AboutPage.title: About
AboutPage.message1: This is a Pokémon application built with React, TypeScript, and GraphQL API. The application allows users to browse Pokémon information.
AboutPage.message2: This app is not just another pet project. It is the result of training at RS School, written using a modern stack: GraphQL, React, and TypeScript.
AboutPage.message3: How was it created? Honestly: I come home from work, and instead of relaxing, I sit at the computer - and stay there until late at night. All this code was written in my free time after hard workdays. I invested not only knowledge into it, but also patience and the desire to create something truly high-quality.
AboutPage.message4: This project is living proof that it is possible to combine work, life, and serious development. And that RS School teaches real skills, not just a checkbox.
AboutPage.message6: If you also want to master React, improve your TypeScript, and understand how modern frontend tools work, come to RS School.
AboutPage.message8: Real projects, mentorship, a community, and a path that will make even a complex stack feel like home await you. Do not be afraid to start—I did it. And you can definitely do it too.
